midcycle_gap.basis: LTM: committed financial_summary EBIT ÷ revenue (last actual column); median: EDGAR companyfacts OperatingIncomeLoss / Revenues — reported median over 19 FY; flagged at ≥5 points; sources said to agree within 2
midcycle_gap.read: The last twelve months' operating margin of 29.7% (CIQ EBIT) sits 18.2 points ABOVE the 19-year median of 11.5% (EDGAR GAAP operating income) that R1 reverts to. R1 pairs that median with the median multiple from the same history, so an R1 value answers what the business is worth if it is still what it was. If the gap is STRUCTURAL — a changed mix or model — that history understates it; if it is a cyclical PEAK, reverting is right. The two sources agree within 0.0 points on FY2025, so the gap is the business, not the source.
